meta.name: add-github
meta.description: Add GitHub channel integration via Chat SDK. PR and issue comment threads as conversations.

copy.tagline: 将 PR 和 Issue 评论变为聊天讨论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果正在开发聊天应用并想让团队在会话中讨论代码。
copy.tagline_en: Turn GitHub PR and issue discussions into chat conversations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're building a chat app and want to sync GitHub discussions.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能通过专用机器人账号加入 GitHub 的 PR 和 issue 评论线程：被 @ 时发言，并跟进之后的同伴评论。
howto.when: 当被监控仓库的 PR 或 issue 评论中有人准确 @ 机器人账号时触发；首次 @ 后该线程被订阅，接下来所有评论都会响应。

say.text: 给 GitHub 的 PR 评论加上机器人
say.note: 会执行注册、安装和 webhook 设置

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can join GitHub PR and issue comment threads using a dedicated bot account: it replies when @-mentioned and keeps following the thread afterward.
howto.when_en: Triggers when someone @-mentions the bot account exactly in a PR or issue comment on a monitored repo; after the first mention the thread is subscribed and all follow-up comments are handled.

say_en.note: Claude copies the adapter and asks about repo visibility.

say_en.text: Add a GitHub bot for PR comments.
say_en.note: Registers, installs, and sets up the webhook.

say_en.text: I have the bot token ready, let's add GitHub.
